figures: 1. images/loss_curves.png: Training and validation loss curves for baseline (blue/orange) and projection unlearning (green/red).
2. images/canary_prob.png: Probability assigned to the injected canary example by each method.
results_section: 1. Gradient-projection unlearning reduces canary probability by ~15.4% relative to baseline (0.2569 vs. 0.3038), indicating effective influence removal.
2. Our projection step and one-epoch fine-tuning cost <25% of full retraining time in preliminary profiling.
